north.evidence: N at the tip of a diagonal arrow at upper right of SKETCH PLAN OF SUKHTAGEN-DOR DASHT, reproduced on printed134 of the Japanese compilation. No true, magnetic or grid label is present.
north.survey_year_evidence: The same page names Aurel Stein (Archaeological Survey of India) in 1928; plan credited Stein 1931.

scale.evidence: Bar at upper left marked 0 and 100m.

lines.identification: Stein 1931 sketch reproduced in Japanese compilation, printed134, PDF40: straight northern wall labelled Remains of Town Wall. Dales 1962, printed4-5, identifies the citadel's Harappan fortification.
Same Stein sketch, straight eastern fortification above the gap and lower knoll, excluding contour lines.
Same Stein sketch, short straight north-south masonry wing rising from the northern wall at its eastern end.
Same Stein sketch, straight western fortification above its middle interruption; selected inside the hatched masonry band, not on adjacent contours.
Same Stein sketch, continuation of western wall below the middle interruption, ending before the curved southern gateway complex.
